description: Update fields on one of your own time entries (PATCH — only the fields you supply are changed; everything else is left as-is). Supply the time_report_id plus any combination of date, start_time, hours, and text.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

time_report_id.description: Id of the time entry to update.

name: update_time_report
